claim.claim-text: 2. The system of claim 1, wherein the learning engine is operable to recommend and/or perform actions based on historical data, external data sources, machine learning (ML), artificial intelligence (AI), neural networks (NNs) and/or other learning techniques.
3. The system of claim 1, wherein the semantic engine is operable to run autonomously.
4. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one data analysis engine includes an identification engine operable to identify a device or an emitter transmitting at least one signal of interest.
5. The system of claim 1, wherein a learning engine software development kit (SDK) is operable to convert a training model for operation in another electromagnetic environment.
6. The system of claim 5, wherein the training model includes a machine learning (ML) model, an artificial intelligence (AI) model, a deep learning (DL) model, or a neural network (NN) model.
7. The system of claim 1, wherein the actionable data relates to interference mitigation or interference prevention.
8. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one server is operable to send at least one notification based on the actionable data in real time or near real time.
9. The system of claim 1, wherein the system is operable to provide reconfiguration options relating to time, frequency, and/or spatial settings.

18. The method of claim 16, wherein the learning engine is operable to recommend and/or perform actions based on historical data, external data sources, machine learning (ML), artificial intelligence (AI), neural networks (NNs) and/or other learning techniques.

19. 20. The method of claim 19, wherein the actionable data relates to interference mitigation or interference prevention.
